kind: Post-hoc descriptive audit of preserved model receipts; not organizer evaluation or a new inference experiment.
population: All 258 generated draft/editor pairs in the official Task 2 run; administrative closures excluded.
comparison: Exact draft text (parsed JSON text field) versus editor response text; no whitespace normalization. Editor input draft checked for equality.
limits: Output changes do not measure quality. Original drafts have no matched organizer human-likeness ratings; no causal editor benefit or harm is established.
